title: Independently recount #4545's PR4470 transport census: 3,302/2,856 per orientation, 406 new pairs vs PR4447 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4545-transport-census-check/`, an independent recount of the transport census in Clear1nsight's #4545 (head `6034837d`), using my own frame tracking on main's pinned #4470 constructor. The constructor also emits the pre-patch PR4447 word. **All recounted figures are confirmed. No new κ.**

| | #4470 forward | #4470 backward | PR4447 word |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| transport occurrences | **3,302** | **3,302** | 3,355 |
| distinct `(E, F)` pairs | **2,856** | **2,856** | 2,934 |

- **New pairs.** There are **406** distinct pairs new relative to PR4447, compared by exact ordered frame bases. The same 406 arise in both orientations.
- **Helper owners.** There are 408 among 632 persistent fields.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4545-transport-census-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4545-transport-census-check outcome=completed   (~2 s, stdlib only)
```

**Limitation:** #4545's 17 helper-boundary recipes and its recipe matching are not recounted, and physical recipes are not re-lowered.

Head: `618096061351465f38ddbdf437cb35c898451298`. Base: canonical main `f626db5c`.

Credit: Clear1nsight (#4545), Cinna Davis (#4470). Prepared by Ryanson Jonathan with substantial Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) assistance.
